mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 56 degrees. The air quality index is at a moderate 62, and we are under a new moon phase tonight. Expect an overnight low of 54 degrees with no rain predicted.

The Verona Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a long-range vision developed with community input to guide growth, housing, and infrastructure over the next decade. Additionally, the city is continuing its regular engineering service reports to keep our infrastructure on track.

We have a full slate of activities, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Square, live music at Paddy Mac's, and the international Puppets in the House festival at Century School Park.
In a notable call from September 28, officers responded to a motor vehicle accident where a 16-year-old operating an eMoto in a reckless manner collided with an SUV.
Today's flavor is OREO Cookie Overload. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up scoops until they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
